svg.title: An ICT lesson in a Sri Lankan classroom
svg.desc: A teacher in a maroon saree points with chalk to a chalkboard showing input, process and output, a row of binary digits and a small network. Students in white school uniforms sit at wooden desks: a girl with plaited hair tied with ribbons raises her hand, two students share one phone, and a boy writes in an exercise book. Coconut palms are visible through an open window. There are no computers in the room.
